race.title: Ascot Shared Ownership Weekend Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: MOVEIT LIKE MINNIE ran a cracker when third in a better race over C&D last time, finishing ahead of 3 of today's rivals, and he gets the nod in a tricky handicap. Recent Newton Abbot winner Intellotto is a serious danger if repeating that effort, with Ooh Betty potentially interesting back in calmer waters. MOVEIT LIKE MINNIE (IRE) INTELLOTTO (IRE) OOH BETTY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Gambino (4/1), Fasol (9/2), Moveit Like Minnie (5/1), Williethebuilder (6/1), Wondering Why (6/1), Intellotto (7/1), Brendas Asking (8/1), Ooh Betty (10/1)
